caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pot placed against a plain, light beige background. The pot is round with a wide opening at the top, a thickened rim, and a slight lip near the base. It has a glaze with a mottled appearance, featuring a blend of earthy green and orange-brown hues, interspersed with lighter patches and irregular shapes. The shading and highlights suggest a glossy surface, particularly on the upper rim and sides, indicating the reflective quality of the glaze. There are no other objects or design elements present in the composition, and the pot is centered on the page. The drawing includes a faint printed label beneath the pot that reads "BLENKO & YGER."
title: Galena Pottery (Bowl)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
